note: Committed snapshot — cold-start floor. Live fetch attempted on each cost_model.py run.

engineer_hourly.basis: PayScale survey, Machine Learning Engineer, US, base salary median, 1061 salary profiles, last updated Jun 06 2026. Hourly = annual / 2080.

roboflow_managed.note: Roboflow uses a credits-based model. No public per-stream or per-inference price is listed. Managed GPU clusters and priority GPU access are Enterprise (custom, sales) pricing. Core plan: $39/mo (monthly) includes 20 credits ($3.90/credit), scaling to 500 credits/mo at $1,399. Additional credits: $4+ prepaid or $6 on-demand per credit.

plan_tiers.derived_from: raw_pricing_text (same as_of and source_url as roboflow_managed); only stated anchors are encoded

enterprise.includes: priority GPU access, volume pricing, uptime SLA, managed GPU cluster

plan_tiers.not_encoded: intermediate Core tiers between the floor and ceiling; per-inference, per-stream, or per-FPS credit consumption

roboflow_managed.raw_pricing_text: Public: Free ($0/month, 10 credits/month). Core: $39/month, 20 credits/month ($3.90 per credit), scaling up to 500 credits/month at $1,399 ($2.86 per credit). Additional credits at $4+ per credit (prepaid, expire after 1 year) or $6 per credit (on-demand). Enterprise: custom pricing (priority GPU access, volume pricing, uptime SLA). Managed GPU cluster: Enterprise only.
